_comment: S4 acceptance 2(b). `Text(verbatim:)` tells SwiftUI 'this string is NOT a key' — which is
right for a value and wrong for a sentence, and the two look identical in a diff. So every
site is named here with the reason it is a value, and `UILintTests.verbatimTextIsAllowlisted`
fails on any site this file does not list.
The rule for adding one: a `Text(verbatim:)` is legitimate ONLY when the string is (a) a
proper noun or the source's own words, (b) a value a `FormatStyle` produced, or (c) already
localised on the line above. Anything else is a sentence and belongs in the catalog.
`file` + `expression` must match the argument text exactly, so a NEW site fails the lint
even in a file that already has one — a per-file exemption would let a sentence slip in
